title: Glowline Garden
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small single-pass 180-second stereo master; a continuous 128-second excerpt from 32s forms the station mix and its first 64 seconds form the game mix; -8 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Create an original 180-second stereo melodic house instrumental at a steady 126 BPM in 4/4 for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game. By 24 seconds a complete dance groove is established: four-on-the-floor kick, clear clap on two and four, offbeat hats, round bass, gentle bright chord stabs and a separate short plucked synth attack every quarter beat. Signature hook: two low notes grow to four rising plucks, answered by a wide held chord. Keep the continuous 32-to-160-second passage full and nearly even in loudness; vary chords, bass roots and the reply after 96 seconds without dropping drums or melody. Distinct, warm and uplifting electronic composition. No vocals, speech, samples, tempo drift, copied melody, quiet breakdown, long build or fade in the selected passage.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original comic-print cover: a branching grid of glowing frequency lines grows into four angular leaf-like wave tips around a coral central beat, no literal flowers, people, instruments, sun or text.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Horizontal duohertz panel with branching frequency garden motif on right and Glowline Garden title on left.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
